sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered height vector assigned to the fixed left-to-right bar slots.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Measure every solid bar height around the carrier and order the measured vector according to height_order.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Redraw each original slot with its preserved width and color using the assigned height, centered with the canonical even-height convention.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Every bar's final top and bottom extents are calculated from the ordered vector; changing that vector changes the rendered output while leaving the input slots fixed.

parametric_work.summary: Reviewer-ready native prototype. The lesson measures all bar heights around a common carrier, orders the derived vector, and redraws fixed slots from that intermediate.

target.summary: Built a general bar-height sorting family with an exact canonical ascending default, a descending matched-input setting, 2–6 demonstrations, four sequential queries, protected-Racket preflight, bounded rival audit, privacy-safe exports, and causal replay.
